name: Moncalieri (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the full achievement of the municipal arms of Moncalieri (a white cross on red within a bordure, crowned, with bear supporters and mantling).
history: Municipal flag of Moncalieri, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Moncalieri arms — white cross on red, crowned, with bear supporters
